description: A U+FEFF before a traversal in a JSON string is ignored in static analysis
notes: The spec reads the string's content as a native syntax expression, and the native syntax doesn't permit byte order marks (hclsyntax/spec.md, Source Code Representation), so the content isn't a valid traversal. hashicorp/hcl reads the content with hclsyntax.ParseTraversalAbs (expression.AsTraversal in json/structure.go), whose scanner removes a leading UTF-8 byte order mark from any source (stripUTF8BOM in hclsyntax/token.go).
